sourceProducts.description:
2026 Topps NOW Road to Opening Day kicks off the 2026 MLB season with a Team Set for all 30 MLB teams and exclusive Spring Training photography.

Subject List:

Ronald Acuña Jr. - parallel subject

Michael Harris II

Chris Sale

Mauricio Dubón

Austin Riley

Matt Olson - parallel subject

Ozzie Albies - parallel subject

Drake Baldwin - parallel subject

Robert Suarez

Spencer Strider

Base Card Parallels (1 per set)

/99 Green Foil

/50 Gold Foil

/25 Orange Foil

/10 Black Foil

/5 Red Foil

1/1 FoilFractor

Earn Bonus Cards!

Purchasers of this set have the chance to earn Topps NOW® bonus cards! The following milestones trigger an exclusive bonus card(s) order over the course of the 2026 season (Opening Day through World Series)

Team's player hits for cycle
Team's player hits 3 HRs in a game
Team's pitcher throws 15 Ks in a game
Team's individual pitcher throws a no-hitter or perfect game

All sales are final. Print runs revealed after sales window expires. Art subject to change. Not responsible for typographical/printer errors.
